test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

The snowstorm in that region __will effect thousand__ of travellers.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'will affect thousands'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is **not grammatically correct.**
 
• The underlined segment contains **an error.**
 
• We need to substitute it with the **improvement **suggestion given in one of the options.
 
• Here,** effect,** which is a noun, is **erroneous** here as, in this sentence, we require a **verb**.
 
• The verb** 'affect' **basically means *to have an influence or have an impact on something.*__
 
• The given sentence implies that the snowstorm in that region will affect thousands of travellers.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
